geometry_edits.rationale: Upgrade the generic puncture to a courtyard macro to produce a real public void and better neighborhood ground condition.
Make the void proportionally larger so it functions as usable open space.
Align the void opening with the verified access side.
Broaden the split to clarify hierarchy and support a more legible between-space.
Raise the ground spine slightly to strengthen the active threshold at grade.

graph_edits.rationale: Replace shallow puncturing with a true courtyard-void operator so the ground plane can become legible public space.
Enlarge the void enough to read as usable open space rather than incidental subtraction.
Open the courtyard to the verified access side to repair the frontage relationship and create an active entry condition.
Widen the split to make the dominant gesture read as one compound mass with a meaningful between-space.
Strengthen the ground linkage so the split-wing figure anchors to the street edge instead of floating as two blocks.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent compact mass in all four views, with clear split-wing hierarchy and good repair integrity. However, the visible form is still dominated by a generic boxy two-part extrusion with shallow punctures, and the green parcel is not being transformed into a meaningful public void or terrace figure. The blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly; there is no strong ground opening, court, or entry seam aligned to it. For the neighborhood_living brief, the mass can plausibly support mixed-use only if it develops a more legible active ground threshold and a clearer public-space section. As shown, it is not program-fit hard-pass because the section remains too sealed and typologically generic for the requested active street building with one clear public void.

warnings: Parcel containment appears acceptable, but the ground/public threshold is underdeveloped.
The silhouette is coherent only as a simple split volume, not as a program-bearing sectional figure.
Access-edge response is semantically weak: the blue frontage is not met by a clear opening or court.
Do not over-read the punctures as usable public voids; they remain small and decorative.
